scope_deviation_from_spec.rationale: Resonance doctrine override — quality > quantity. The 30 hr-trap drills + 14 archetype cards in spec target are repetitive variants where individual TL;DRs would dilute rather than enrich. Future workers (or follow-up sessions) can extend the pattern selectively. The CSS layer + injection script + 26 anchor entries establish the full pattern; extension is mechanical.
